suite.name: formal_detail_mix_kvasir_v2
suite.purpose: Two additional fresh initializations of the four Kvasir arms, so that seed-level evidence rests on five seeds instead of three. Seeds 669 and 670 were never trained or evaluated before.
suite.prompt: a polyp in a colonoscopy image
suite.hyperparameters: identical to formal_detail_mix_kvasir_v1 (config derived from it; only the seed differs)
reported_not_gating: the same contrasts on the two new seeds alone (the only seeds not seen when the combination question was raised)
image-level tests, bootstrap intervals, gain concentration, unique-image sensitivity
disclosures: The five test sets were used before; seeds 666-668 results on them are already known.
ColonDB and CVC300 share 52 exact image hashes and are not independent cohorts.
